examples.text: Two navy Kestrel Reserve credit cards side by side, standing on edge, leaning slightly back, the left one showing its front and the right one its back, seen at eye level, on a café counter next to a card payment terminal and a takeaway coffee, barista area blurred behind, warm morning light.
